title: Store Operations Scheduling Standard for Immunization Services Appointments
content:
Immunization Services appointments are booked against a vaccination course, one dose at a time. The figures named below (booking window days, same-day cutoff minutes, slot length, open appointments per course, automatic next-dose booking and its offset, walk-in marker and appointment-required age, no-show limit and suspension days) are those of the course's vaccination in the product tables.

## S-1 Course status
An appointment is booked only on a course in scheduled or in progress status. A completed or cancelled course takes no appointment.

## S-2 Open appointments
A course has no more than its vaccination's open-appointments-per-course figure of open appointments. An appointment is open while it has not been ended by a cancellation, a no-show or a dose given against it. A patient who wants a different time has the open appointment cancelled first.

## S-3 Date and time
- The appointment date is no more than the booking window days after today.
- A same-day slot is bookable only until the same-day cutoff minutes before it starts.
- Slots start on the store's appointment slot grid, spaced by the slot length.
- For a later dose, the appointment date is no earlier than the earliest valid date for that dose under the dose administration rules (minimum intervals less the grace period days).

## S-4 Automatic next-dose booking
Where the vaccination books the next dose automatically, the next dose is booked when a series dose is given, on the date of that dose plus the offset days, at the same store and time, with the booking channel recorded as auto-booked.

## S-5 Walk-in doses
A walk-in dose needs no booking where the vaccination allows walk-ins and the patient is at least the appointment-required age.

## S-6 No-show suspension
When the patient's no-shows in the rolling 365 calendar days ending today, counted across all of the patient's courses, have reached the vaccination's no-show limit, online and phone booking is closed to the patient for the suspension days counted from the latest no-show, and only walk-in doses may be given.

## Points of judgement

| Record shows | Booking |
|---|---|
| Course scheduled or in progress, no open appointment | May be booked, within S-3 |
| Course scheduled or in progress, one open appointment and a figure of 1 | Not booked while that appointment stays open |
| Course completed or cancelled | Not booked |
| No-shows in rolling 365 days at the limit, within the suspension days from the latest no-show | Online and phone booking closed; walk-in doses only |

## Hypothetical boundary cases

- Booking window of 30 days, booked today: an appointment 30 days ahead is within the window; 31 days ahead is not.
- No-show limit of 2 and suspension of 90 days: with 2 no-shows in the rolling 365 days, the latest dated day 0, phone booking is closed through the suspension days counted from day 0. With 1 no-show in that window the limit has not been reached.
